gaps.title: Bandwidth-aware prioritized sync and store-and-forward data movement between edge applications and the NGC2/TAK data layer (policy-driven 'what leaves first, at what fidelity' and COP-edit reconciliation on reconnect)
gaps.problem: NGC2 applications assume a data layer that stays coherent, but tactical links are intermittent and thin, so nodes need a policy-driven way to decide what data leaves first, at what fidelity, and how conflicting COP edits are reconciled on reconnection - today handled by vendor-specific mesh logic, bespoke per-application code and manual deconfliction.
gaps.user: NGC2 application developers, division/brigade G6/S6 and hub operators, fires, intel and logistics cells whose products compete for the same links, Air Force expeditionary units

gaps.title: Battalion-and-below DDIL-native orders, planning and battle-tracking app bridging dismounted TAK and Onebrief-class HQ planning (structured orders, reports and tracking that survive displaced, low-bandwidth command posts)
gaps.problem: Between the dismounted TAK client and the division-level planning suite, company and battalion staffs still run orders, tracking and reports on chat, voice, paper and PowerPoint in displaced, low-bandwidth command posts, and SBMC/Nett Warrior will put a C2 client on every leader by FY28 without structured orders content to feed it.
gaps.user: Company commanders, battalion S3/S2 staffs and TOC battle captains in Transformation-in-Contact formations, SOF teams, allied light forces

gaps.title: Government-reference-architecture conformance, synthetic-scenario and T&E harness for autonomy and PNT plug-ins (A-GRA, FANTOM Core, UMAA, IOP; pntOS/ASPN and NAVWAR-compliance evidence)
gaps.problem: As services assert reference architectures for autonomy and PNT, every vendor and program must prove conformance and NAVWAR compliance, but the government's planned compliance toolkits, M&S fidelity and field-test capacity are thin, so each integration remains bespoke, slow and expensive.
gaps.user: Program-office T&E leads (CCA, PMS 406, SOCOM PEO-SOF Warrior, PM PNT/NAVWAR compliance reviewers), autonomy vendors (Shield AI, Collins, small drone makers), alt-PNT sensor vendors (DIU TQS cohort, LEO-PNT, MagNav, vision-nav), AFRL/NAVAIR labs

gaps.title: Multi-source in-transit visibility fusion for contested movement (RFID, satellite trackers, carrier EDI and manifests into a trusted COP that survives disconnected legs)
gaps.problem: USTRANSCOM lacks near-real-time, end-to-end in-transit visibility that fuses RFID, satellite trackers, carrier EDI and manifests into a trusted picture that survives contested and disconnected legs.
gaps.user: USTRANSCOM DDOC/Fusion Center staff, 618th Air Operations Center, theater distribution centers, TSC distribution management centers
